legal_mapping: Victims’ Code — right to updates and clarity about investigations

summary: Caller presents two similar crime references (July 1246 and November 4305), causing cognitive load while seeking clarity on which is which. Operator confirms both as stalking, provides the November date, and ultimately discloses the OIC name (PC Dixon) for both, then confirms a third reference (47250093423) with PC Russell. Operator notes one reference showing as ‘crime other’.

contradictions.claim: Call handler disclosed the OIC’s name(s) over the phone after initially saying they could not discuss details.
impact: Personal data disclosure without formal verification
Confirms continuity that both July and November were with same OIC
